slides.heading: S1 — Export
slides.note: Export packages serve as safe restore points before bulk data edits.
steps: Open Settings and navigate to Database tab.
Access Export utility.
Select target data package (Full catalog, dishes, tax, master tables).
Export data package to secure local archive file.
Always take an export snapshot before major menu restructuring.

slides.heading: S2 — Import
slides.note: Verify all imported records on a test till before opening live service.
steps: Open Import utility under Database settings.
Select approved master file provided by Admin or Isarva support.
Validate file format and confirm import execution.
Wait for database import to process completely.
Audit menu, tax, and categories immediately following import.

slides.heading: S3 — Backup
slides.note: Routine database backups prevent business data loss during hardware failures.
steps: Access Backup utility from Database tab.
Initiate complete database backup snapshot.
Download and store encrypted backup file in a secure repository.
Schedule regular daily/weekly backup milestones.
Execute disaster recovery restore only with Isarva support guidance.

slides.heading: S4 — Data Cleaning
slides.note: Data Cleaning irreversibly wipes transaction logs; exercise extreme caution.
steps: Open Data Cleaning utility under Database tab.
Strictly use only for training tills or demo data clearing.
Never execute Data Cleaning on live production restaurant data.
Requires high-level Admin authentication and explicit confirmation.
Execute data purge only under supervised Isarva technical support.
